title: Ultimate Guide To Digital Marketing Success in 2023

facts.fact: The article was published on January 2, 2021, by Donald Chan, in the Digital Marketing category, though its title refers to 2023.
The guide says it distills eight critical steps to digital marketing success in 2023.
facts.quote: we’ve distilled eight critical steps you need to take to bring about digital marketing success in 2023

facts.fact: The page states that Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager are both free services from Google.
facts.quote: which are both free services from Google and easy to install and use

facts.fact: The page says marketing automation software should include web visitor identification and analytics, lead scoring, behaviour tracking, email automation and dynamic forms.
facts.quote: they should include tools such as web visitor identification and analytics, lead scoring, behaviour tracking, email automation and dynamic forms

facts.fact: The page names Marketo, Eloqua and SharpSpring, alongside HubSpot, as common marketing automation software.
The page lists page views, unique visitors, click-through rates, cost per click and conversion rates as basic digital marketing metrics.
facts.quote: Some of the more basic metrics include page views, unique visitors, click-through rates, cost per clicks and conversion rates.
